description_en: Azerpoltrade Ltd. is a partner of Azerbaijani holding company Azersun and the largest distributor of Azerbaijani food products in Europe, based in Warsaw. We have in our portfolio a wide range of world-class (Orange Pekoe) Azercay and Berga teas, cold-pressed (NFC) natural pomegranate juice and Saville pomegranate sauce, and Bizim Tarla jams, vegetable preserves and compotes.
